source.title: WCA Regulations - February 2023
source.content:
Dear WCA Community,

The WRC would like to inform you about the versions of the WCA Regulations and Guidelines, which are going into effect **February 1, 2023.**

You can review all changes in [this comparison on GitHub](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2022-06-01...official-2023-02-01). You can click on “Files changed” to see the complete files of the Regulation and Guidelines, where all changes and additions are marked green and removals are red.

Below is a *summary* of the major changes in the new version of the Regulations and the Guidelines.

**Major Changes**

- Allow both a cumulative time limit and a time limit (per attempt) to be present at the same time ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1063/files) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/proposal-allow-for-both-cumulative-time-limits-and-time-limits/16323))
- Make Square-1 misalignments during inspection more clear ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1073/files) | [discussion](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/move-vs-alignment-clarification-on-square-1-in-inspection/20873))
- Remove Gen 2 Stackmats from the list of approved timers ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1067/files))
- Add 4g2 for clock ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1070/files))
- Defining clock better in the regulations ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1076/files))
- More clarification on extras in the guidelines ([PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1060/files))

translation.title: WCA 竞赛规则更新（2023 年 2 月）
translation.content:
各位 WCA 社区成员：

WCA 规则委员会（WRC）在此通知，新版《WCA 竞赛规则与指南》将于 **2023 年 2 月 1 日**生效。

所有改动可在 [GitHub 版本对比](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/compare/official-2022-06-01...official-2023-02-01)中查看。点击“Files changed”即可查看规则与指南的完整文件，其中新增和修改的内容标为绿色，删除的内容标为红色。

以下是新版规则与指南主要改动的*概要*。

**主要改动**

- 允许同时设置累计时限和单次还原时限（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1063/files) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/proposal-allow-for-both-cumulative-time-limits-and-time-limits/16323)）
- 进一步明确 Square-1 在观察期间未对齐的处理（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1073/files) | [讨论](https://forum.worldcubeassociation.org/t/move-vs-alignment-clarification-on-square-1-in-inspection/20873)）
- 将第二代 Stackmat 从认可计时器名单中移除（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1067/files)）
- 为魔表增加规则 4g2（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1070/files)）
- 在规则中进一步明确魔表的定义（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1076/files)）
- 在指南中进一步说明额外还原的处理（[PR](https://github.com/thewca/wca-regulations/pull/1060/files)）
